message.skyabyss.raiju.begin: The lightning in the knuckle gathers into one point, and takes the shape of a beast...
message.skyabyss.raiju.hint_plug: Pull the plug at a rod's foot to ground it. A beast that lands on a grounded rod falls.
message.skyabyss.raiju.grounded_fall: The raiju struck a grounded rod and fell, stunned!
message.skyabyss.raiju.roar: The raiju roars. Lightning is called to your feet!
message.skyabyss.raiju.plug_pulled: You pulled the plug. The rod is grounded (%s s)
message.skyabyss.raiju.plug_wait: The plug has not settled yet (%s s)
message.skyabyss.raiju.after: The lightning gathered in the knuckle lost its home, and ran from rod to rod again and again.
message.skyabyss.raiju.east_stone_ready: At the crown of the knuckle, a wind chime stone waits to ring.
message.skyabyss.raiju.asleep: The raiju sleeps. Nothing stirs while the world is peaceful.
message.skyabyss.raiju.go: Raiju's nest: walk in to begin (5 s). /skyabyss raiju start to begin now
message.skyabyss.raiju.go_temporary: Raiju's nest (temporary, in the overworld sky until the storm back exists). Walk in to begin
